messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty P1: auth-proxy 5xx spike + token_replay_detect from 203.0.113.0/24. INC-2026-457 created.
eli: @oncall-bot I'm on it — which region is the noise in?
oncall-bot: Metrics show concentrated spike in eu-central-1 starting ~14:10 UTC, sustained for 3m.
sophia: pulling logs now, enabling proxy debug for sample window. @maria can you assess exposure risk?
maria: quick hit: data-forwarder sent debug logs to s3://redwood-archive-eu/dev-logs-xyz. Need to check whether Authorization headers were captured.
jordan: I'll pause the forwarder in eu-central-1 immediately.
eli: Do that + apply emergency rate-limit for the suspect IP range.
jordan: Executing — commands below.
```
# pause forwarder
infractl forwarder pause --id ff-824 --region eu-central-1
# block IP range at WAF
aws wafv2 update-ip-set --name auth-suspect --addresses 203.0.113.0/24 --scope REGIONAL --region eu-central-1
```
jordan: ff-824 paused, WAF updated, 203.0.113.0/24 now blocked.
maria: good. Next step: rotate service credentials used by log-forwarder + indexer. I'll run the rekey sequence and revoke old tokens.
sec-lead: quick customer-impact check: looks like AcmeCorp has elevated 401/403 spikes from eu-central. Could be replay against their tenant. Please engage CSM if we confirm leaked tokens.
eli: Any confirmed objects with tokens inside? @sophia?
sophia: sampled objects show header snippets like 'Authorization: Bearer eyJ...' in 4 objects (likely debug-level captures). Pulling full object list for that prefix now.
maria: emergency keyswap plan: rotate forwarder IAM keys, rotate indexer write role, revoke sessions tied to those creds, then run replay-detection.
eli: Go ahead. Post the commands we should run so infra can follow.
maria: running rotation now, commands and steps: 
```
# create new access keys for the forwarder service account
aws iam create-access-key --user-name log-forwarder-eu --region eu-central-1
# push secrets into Secrets Manager
aws secretsmanager put-secret-value --secret-id /services/log-forwarder-eu/creds --secret-string '{"accessKeyId":"NEW_ID","secretAccessKey":"NEW_SECRET"}' --region eu-central-1
# revoke old sessions (all tokens tied to service principal)
authctl revoke-sessions --service log-forwarder-eu --all
```
maria: rotation commands executed. Old keys invalidated, SecretsManager rotated. Recording details in INC-2026-457.
devex: I'll draft a customer-facing note for AcmeCorp and legal-safe language. Share draft in 30m unless sec says otherwise.
sec-lead: legal loop engaged. Request S3 object deletion + audit: set lifecycle/delete flag for the bucket prefix and mark objects for immediate redact where tokens are found.
jordan: updated bucket ACL to private, lifecycle rule applied to delete flagged objects after 1 hour, started redact job for known objects.
oncall-bot: INC-2026-457 status updated -> Mitigating. Next update scheduled +15m.
eli: Thanks. I'll stay on bridge. @maria ping when full scan completes and replay detection finishes.
maria: full rotation done, old keys invalidated, redaction job completed for identified objects. Kicking off full-scan across prefix now — ETA ~25-30m. Will update INC when scan done.
sec-lead: once scan completes, prepare incident notification + timeline and schedule postmortem. Good containment so far.
eli: noting timeline and next steps. Stand by for final confirmation then we can close pager. :thumbsup:
